examples.description: Generate an original e-invoice for a registered buyer
Issue a credit note against an original whose LHDN UUID is recorded
Invoice a monthly retainer for the month it covers

failure_modes.recovery: Complete myinvois_settings_save first; send line_items as [{description, quantity, unit_price_cents, …}] and either customer_id or an inline buyer {name, tin}.
failure_modes.when: the supplier profile is missing, line_items are malformed, no buyer was given, or invoice_type 02/03/04 lacks original_invoice_id

failure_modes.recovery: Send the dates the invoice covers, for example {start_date: "2026-06-01", end_date: "2026-06-30", frequency: "Monthly"}, or leave billing_period out.
failure_modes.when: billing_period has a date that is not a real YYYY-MM-DD, ends before it starts, or is the Monthly placeholder that starts and ends on the issue date

failure_modes.recovery: Type the quote mark (") itself in the named field, or remove it, then generate again. Nothing was saved and no number was used.
failure_modes.when: a text value (a line description, the buyer, notes, payment terms or the supplier profile) holds the HTML entity ", which the stored copy cannot keep

failure_modes.recovery: Call myinvois_customer_list / myinvois_invoice_list to find valid ids.
failure_modes.when: customer_id or original_invoice_id does not name a row in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Key the original into the MyInvois portal form (myinvois_invoice_read returns its portal_field_sheet), record the UUID the portal assigns via myinvois_invoice_record_submission, then retry.
failure_modes.when: the referenced original is not a type-01 invoice (chained notes are rejected) or has no recorded LHDN UUID yet

preconditions: invoice_number is server-claimed (atomic per-tenant sequence) — any value you send is ignored.
Money is integer CENTS (unit_price_cents) and basis points (tax_rate_bps: 600 = 6%).
Credit (02), debit (03) and refund (04) notes REQUIRE original_invoice_id naming a type-01 invoice that already has an LHDN UUID.

Generation seals the document; Simpler never submits it to LHDN. The owner keys its portal_field_sheet into the MyInvois portal form (LHDN's other portal route is its Excel batch template), then records the UUID the portal assigns via myinvois_invoice_record_submission.

description: Mint a sealed LHDN e-invoice in ONE call: invoice_type, line_items (unit_price_cents in integer CENTS, tax_rate_bps in basis points), and a buyer as customer_id or an inline buyer object. Refuses until myinvois_settings_save is done; invoice_type 02/03/04 also needs original_invoice_id naming a type-01 invoice with a recorded LHDN UUID, checked BEFORE the number is claimed, so a rejected note never burns a number. The result is immutable and carries portal_field_sheet; Simpler never submits it to LHDN. NEXT: the owner keys the field sheet into the MyInvois portal form, then myinvois_invoice_record_submission with the UUID the portal assigns.

billing_period.description: Optional LHDN billing period {start_date, end_date, frequency?}: dates as YYYY-MM-DD, end on or after start, frequency up to 50 characters (for example Monthly). Leave it out when the invoice covers no period; the e-invoice then carries none.

buyer.description: Inline one-off buyer party — {name, tin, brn?, address?, city?, state_code?, postal_code?, country_code?, email?, contact_number?}. Required when customer_id is not given; ignored when it is.

line_items.description: Line items: [{description, quantity, unit_price_cents, tax_rate_bps?, tax_type?, classification_code?, unit_code?}]. Money is integer CENTS, tax_rate_bps is basis points (600 = 6%); tax_type/classification_code/unit_code default when omitted and validate against the LHDN code tables (GET /api/myinvois/codes).

notes.description: Free-text notes printed on the generated e-invoice; optional.

original_invoice_id.description: The type-01 original this note references — required for invoice_type 02, 03 or 04, refused for 01. Must already carry an LHDN UUID (myinvois_invoice_record_submission).

payment_terms.description: Payment terms text for this document; defaults to the supplier profile's default_payment_terms when omitted.

name: myinvois_invoice_generate
